Step 2 [PERFORMANCE]: Reduce JavaScript not required during initial page load (HARD | Est Time: 4 hours) - Reduce JavaScript that is not required during initial page load: Defer non-critical interactive components and third-party scripts using dynamic import() route-based code splitting.

Step 3 [PERFORMANCE]: Minify JavaScript assets to reduce payload size (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Integrate Terser, esbuild, or SWC into your production build pipeline to strip whitespace and shorten identifiers.
Step 4 [PERFORMANCE]: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 13 images that appear below the viewport fold.

Step 5 [SEO]: Define an optimal HTML title element for search indexing (EASY | Est Time: 6 mins) - Define one page-specific <title> tag in the page <head> using the project's existing SEO configuration.

Step 6 [ACCESSIBILITY]: Add descriptive alt attributes to image tags (EASY | Est Time: 30 mins) - Provide descriptive alt="..." text descriptions for all image tags (affecting ~14 images) or empty alt="" for purely decorative graphics.

Step 7 [SEO]: Provide essential Open Graph metadata for social sharing (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add the missing Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image, og:url, og:type) to your document <head>.
